funds.group_notes: Tamil Nadu's Member of Legislative Assembly Constituency Development Scheme (MLACDS) provides Rs.3 crore per constituency per year (Tamil Nadu Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department: https://tnrd.tn.gov.in/rdweb_newsite/project/reports/Public/public_page_table_content_details_view.php?tabular_content_id=NQ==&page_id=Ng==), but only state-wide aggregate figures are published; no per-MLA utilisation data is published, so all values are null.

disclosure.group_notes: Affidavit figures from the candidate's 2021 election affidavit as analysed by ADR/myneta.info.
